### G. W. F. Hegel on wholeness

G. W. F. Hegel (1770–1831) approaches wholeness within German idealism. Reality is intelligible as dialectical development: contradictions in limited standpoints drive Aufhebung—cancellation and preservation at a higher level. Spirit (Geist) comes to know itself through history, culture, and institutions. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets wholeness most directly—useful for searches such as “g. w. f. hegel quotes on wholeness.”
